## `scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/`

| Module | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`archive_run.py`](scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/archive_run.md) | Copy the kept part of a run (retention.py) from SCRATCH to ARCHIVE, check the copy, then make it read-only (stage `archive`, job\_archive.pbs). Nothing in SCRATCH is changed or deleted. |
| [`class_pk.py`](scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/class_pk.md) | CLASS matter power spectra at every planned output redshift of a run, for the P(k) checks (stage vahc). |
| [`make_pkdgrav3_par.py`](scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/make_pkdgrav3_par.md) | Write the pkdgrav3 parameter file of a pipeline run from the variables of its config (environment). |
| [`pk_check.py`](scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/pk_check.md) | P(k) checks of a run (verify\_run.py) and the summary plot &lt;halo dir&gt;/pk/pk\_summary.png. |
| [`retention.py`](scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/retention.md) | What of a run is kept long term, and where it goes (standard library only: used by the jobs and by tools/sahyadri\_manager on the head node). |
| [`scratch_ops.py`](scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/scratch_ops.md) | Scratch operations on the site where a run is computed, for the run manager on another host (it calls this over ssh, e.g. pawna -&gt; pegasus). Prints one JSON object. |
| [`verify_run.py`](scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/verify_run.md) | Check that everything of a run was computed and is consistent, before anything is archived or deleted (stage `verify`, job\_verify.pbs). Writes &lt;state dir&gt;/verify.json; exit 0 only if every check passed. |

## `scripts/post-process/`

| Module | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`ConvertToFITS.py`](scripts/post-process/ConvertToFITS.md) | Convert Rockstar / consistent-trees text outputs to FITS tables (the first FITS converter; the pipeline now uses `compress_halo_outputs.py`). |
| [`Nbody_Compression.py`](scripts/post-process/Nbody_Compression.md) | Lossy compression of N-body snapshots on a grid (the HDF5 `*_<quantity>.h5` format used before snapcomp/.pkc). |
| [`addvalue.py`](scripts/post-process/addvalue.md) | Value-added halo properties from the density field around each halo (class `AddValue`). |
| [`check_compressed_halos.py`](scripts/post-process/check_compressed_halos.md) | check\_compressed\_halos.py: independent check of compress\_halo\_outputs.py results against the ASCII files. |
| [`compress_halo_outputs.py`](scripts/post-process/compress_halo_outputs.md) | compress\_halo\_outputs.py: Rockstar/consistent-trees ASCII outputs -&gt; FITS (.fits.gz) with full metadata. |
| [`compress_test.py`](scripts/post-process/compress_test.md) | Driver that compresses one Sahyadri snapshot into subsamples with `SnapshotReader.compress_snapshot` (paths and snapshot list set in the code; pegasus paths). |
| [`compression12bit.py`](scripts/post-process/compression12bit.md) | Bit packing of floats and integers (8, 12, 16, 32 or 64 bits), used by `Nbody_Compression`. |
| [`correlations.py`](scripts/post-process/correlations.md) | Clustering statistics in a periodic box: two-point correlation functions (`TwoPointCorrelationFunctionPeriodic`, pair counts with a C kernel and the analytic RR of the box) and power spectra (`PowerSpectrum`: CIC or NGP density on a grid, FFT, binned P(k), cross spectra). |
| [`correlations_old.py`](scripts/post-process/correlations_old.md) | Earlier version of `correlations.py` (kept for reference; `correlations.py` is the one in use). |
| [`fits_to_parquet.py`](scripts/post-process/fits_to_parquet.md) | Stage parquet: a Parquet copy of a run's compressed FITS halo tables and trees, in a parallel directory with the same names (FITS stays the reference; the Parquet directory can be dropped without touching it). |
| [`halo_potential_xcorr.py`](scripts/post-process/halo_potential_xcorr.md) | Halo-halo potential cross-correlation: for host halos in mass bins A and B, statistics of the per-halo potentials phi (the pipeline's .vpot columns: mean particle potential within rs, R200b, 0.5/1/1.5 Rvir, ...) over all halo pairs (i in A, j in B) at comoving separation r (Mpc/h), for several phi columns at once. |
| [`halo_table_io.py`](scripts/post-process/halo_table_io.md) | halo\_table\_io.py: the value-added halo tables out\_&lt;snap&gt;.vahc, .tens and .vpot (vahc\_fast.py), as text or binary. |
| [`halo_xi_multipoles.py`](scripts/post-process/halo_xi_multipoles.md) | Halo-halo cross-correlation multipoles xi\_l(s) (l = 0..4, dipole included) between halo mass bins, in real space, redshift space (velocities), with the gravitational-redshift shift from the halo potential, and with both, in a periodic box with a fixed line of sight (plane parallel; default the z axis). Pair counts: Corrfunc theory DDsmu of the cosmodesi/adematti fork (branch desi), which counts signed mu in (-1, 1). |
| [`parquet_http_test.py`](scripts/post-process/parquet_http_test.md) | Round-trip test of Parquet halo tables served over HTTP (range\_http\_server.py): whole-file downloads against DuckDB queries that fetch only the needed column chunks, separate per-table files against one combined file, and a catalogue of views. Wall clock per test: best of 3, each in a fresh DuckDB connection (no cached metadata). Every URL carries ?t=&lt;tag&gt;.&lt;run&gt; so the server log gives the requests and bytes of each test (summarised with --log). |
| [`parquet_layout_test.py`](scripts/post-process/parquet_layout_test.md) | Second Parquet test: float encodings that the first test (parquet\_vs\_fits\_test.py) missed, one combined table per snapshot against separate files, and DuckDB queries on the files. |
| [`parquet_vs_fits_test.py`](scripts/post-process/parquet_vs_fits_test.md) | Test: the pipeline's FITS halo tables (compress\_halo\_outputs.py, .fits.gz) rewritten as Parquet. For each file: sizes, write time, read times (whole table, two columns, a mass cut), and a bit-exact round trip of every column. |
| [`pk_measure.py`](scripts/post-process/pk_measure.md) | Matter and halo power spectra from the density grid that vahc\_fast already builds (stage vahc, --pk). |
| [`pkcreader.py`](scripts/post-process/pkcreader.md) | Reader for compressed pkdgrav3 snapshots (.pkc, docs/snapcomp\_format.md). Needs numpy and zstandard. |
| [`postprocess.py`](scripts/post-process/postprocess.md) | Per-snapshot post-processing of a Gadget/pkdgrav3 run (the original pipeline script). |
| [`postprocess_old.py`](scripts/post-process/postprocess_old.md) | Earlier version of `postprocess.py` (kept for reference). |
| [`range_http_server.py`](scripts/post-process/range_http_server.md) | Minimal read-only HTTP server with Range requests (what DuckDB httpfs, pyarrow/fsspec need to read Parquet column chunks remotely), logging one JSON line per request (path, range, bytes sent, ms) for byte and request counts. |
| [`readers.py`](scripts/post-process/readers.md) | Readers for the Sahyadri snapshots and halo catalogues. |
| [`run_addvalue.py`](scripts/post-process/run_addvalue.md) | run\_addvalue.py: value-added halo catalogs (out\_&lt;snap&gt;.vahc) and tidal tensors (out\_&lt;snap&gt;.tens). |
| [`test_decompress_result.py`](scripts/post-process/test_decompress_result.md) | Test of the compressed snapshot format: compare the decompressed particles of each subsample with the original Gadget snapshot (matched by ID) and plot the error distributions. |
| [`utilities.py`](scripts/post-process/utilities.md) | Shared helpers of the post-processing scripts: `Paths` (code, scratch, simulation and halo directories; `SAHYADRI_SCRATCH` overrides the defaults), `Constants` (physical constants) and `Utilities` (logging, timing, selection helpers). |
| [`vahc_fast.py`](scripts/post-process/vahc_fast.md) | vahc\_fast.py: the value-added catalogues of addvalue.AddValue (out\_&lt;snap&gt;.vahc and out\_&lt;snap&gt;.tens), computed faster. Same quantities, same halos, same smoothing scales, same file format; the numbers agree with AddValue to floating-point rounding (the FFT library and the order of the sums differ). addvalue.py and correlations.py are not changed; run\_addvalue.py uses this module with --fast. |
| [`voronoi_web-LOCAL.py`](scripts/post-process/voronoi_web-LOCAL.md) | Local development copy of `voronoi_web.py` with extra cosmic-web code (needs Aseem's PICASA and cosmology modules; not used by the pipeline). |
| [`voronoi_web.py`](scripts/post-process/voronoi_web.md) | Voronoi volume functions of halos (class `Voronoi`): the Voronoi cell volume of each halo in a mass-threshold sample, estimated with random points, and its distribution (VVF). |
| [`vpot_hdf5.py`](scripts/post-process/vpot_hdf5.md) | vpot\_hdf5.py: the .vpot fields (vahc\_fast.py) for Gadget-4 HDF5 snapshots that store the potential (EVALPOTENTIAL + OUTPUT\_POTENTIAL), so that run\_addvalue.py --fast --pot also writes out\_&lt;snap&gt;.vpot for Gadget-4 runs. |
| [`wan_proxy.py`](scripts/post-process/wan_proxy.md) | HTTP proxy that emulates a wide-area link for parquet\_http\_test.py: each request waits RTT seconds before it is forwarded (one round trip), and the response is sent at most BW bytes/s. Range and HEAD requests pass through. Connection set-up (TCP/TLS handshakes) is not emulated, so real links are somewhat slower for few, small requests. |

## `scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/`

| Module | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`compare_halos.py`](scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/compare_halos.md) | Compare the halo catalogues of a Gadget-4 and a pkdgrav3 run from the same ICs (consistent-trees hlists out\_&lt;snap&gt;.trees and value-added catalogues out\_&lt;snap&gt;.vahc of the Sahyadri pipeline; Rockstar out\_&lt;snap&gt;.list where there is no hlist). |
| [`compare_potential.py`](scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/compare_potential.md) | Compare the gravitational potential of a Gadget-4 and a pkdgrav3 run started from the same ICs, particle by particle and halo by halo, at every common output. |
| [`compare_vpot.py`](scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/compare_vpot.md) | compare\_vpot.py: halo-by-halo comparison of the pipeline's mean particle potential around halos (.vpot columns phi\_&lt;R&gt; of out\_&lt;snap&gt;\_vahc.fits.gz, vahc\_fast.py) between the Gadget-4 and the pkdgrav3 run of the same ICs. |
| [`gadget4_ic_to_gadget2.py`](scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/gadget4_ic_to_gadget2.md) | Convert a Gadget-4 HDF5 initial-conditions file (dark matter only, PartType1) to a Gadget-2 "format 1" binary file that pkdgrav3 reads directly (achInFile; io/fio.c gadgetOpen). |
| [`halo_potential_profile.py`](scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/halo_potential_profile.md) | Stacked gravitational potential around halos: mean and scatter of phi in shells of comoving distance r (Mpc/h) from the halo centres, for halos in mass bins. Gadget-4 HDF5, pkdgrav3 HDF5 or pkdgrav3 .pkc snapshots, so the same statistic can be compared between codes. Only the stacks (per mass bin) are accumulated and stored, never per-halo profiles: memory is independent of the numbers of halos and particles. |
| [`make_gadget4_param.py`](scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/make_gadget4_param.md) | Write a Gadget-4 parameter file from config/sims/run.param.template with the same substitutions as scripts/submit\_CiPod.sh (Sahyadri production), using the variables of the comparison config (environment). |
| [`plot_compare.py`](scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/plot_compare.md) | Figures from compare\_potential.py output.  usage: plot\_compare.py &lt;cmp\_dir&gt; [&lt;fig\_dir&gt;] |
